📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-07-03-ms-scheduler-api-seriesid-negative-recordid`
This is occurrence #138 (chronic, 12+ days running).
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `CRM Experience` (`@customer-management` / `#team-customer-management`)
Playbook: 1) Confirm shape: DD monitor 303056222 in Alert or recently-recovered state. 2) Compute the error-rate ratio (errors/hits over the alert's own last_10m window) — historically marginal (~1-2.5%), do not over-escalate on monitor state alone. 3) Root cause is a code-level missing-guard bug in SeriesDataProvider.GetSeriesIdAsync (not account-specific) — reproduces across many accounts (12+ distinct so far). 4) File/bump a defect for CRM Experience rather than re-diagnosing from scratch each cycle.
Open Jira: none

Source alerts (1 total):
  • n/a — degraded cycle, no Slack MCP this session; DD monitor: https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/303056222 (11:32 UTC)

Evidence:
  • DD monitor: https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/303056222 (OK, self-recovered by scan time)
  • DD metric: 2 errors / 241 hits over the monitor's own 11:22:02-11:32:02Z eval window = 0.83%, back under the 2% threshold — same marginal/self-recovering shape as all 137 prior occurrences
  • Kibana: https://logstash.method.me/app/discover#/?_g=(time:(from:'2026-07-08T11:22:02Z',to:'2026-07-08T11:42:02Z'))&_a=(query:(language:kuery,query:'fields.dd_service.keyword%3A%22ms-scheduler-api%22')) — 2 hits confirmed via raw search this cycle (KB's declared aggregate query on fields.Error.keyword still 0-bucket, documented field-name mismatch)
  • This-window concentration: lafittesseafood 2
